soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question 2 (mixture-sign radius)
soundness_flags.one_line: The perturbed mixture is never named: the statement fixes x in P(b,q,omega) but does not define whether the opposite sign is evaluated at omega' or whether placebo-reference stability and hence the compatible fiber must also change with omega'.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 1 gives sharp bounds for the interval-two challenge effect under Assumptions 1-5; the article also supplies attaining simulations.
The paper defines multi-variant VE measures and studies their temporal properties under leaky and all-or-none mechanisms.
The paper extends weighted estimating equations to changing pathogen distributions under an active-surveillance marked exposure-process model.
The method uses surveillance strain distributions as a proxy for the counterfactual placebo strain distribution after placebo crossover.
The paper distinguishes exposing-strain frequencies from strains observed among cases and states biological interpretation conditions for sieve analyses.
Under stated overlap and missing-at-random assumptions, the paper identifies a conditional case-only odds-ratio target.
The paper constructs asymptotically valid random sets for an identified set and its known image, including uniform validity under conditions.
The paper gives bootstrap calibrated projection intervals for smooth functions in moment-(in)equality models with uniform asymptotic coverage.
The paper derives tight nonparametric treatment-effect bounds with latent variables and linear programming under imperfect compliance.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the mixture-radius wording by an explicit perturbed mixture omega' and define the admissible pair/fiber convention: either retain P(b,q,omega) while evaluating the sign at omega', or rebuild P(b,q,omega') and state how placebo-reference stability is transported. Then give deltaStar as the resulting finite LP or bilevel optimization value.

Add a sensitivity extension with post-noninfecting-exposure response coordinates, or provide a scientifically grounded restricted setting in which stable-noninfecting-history-response is credible; this directly addresses the acknowledged immune-priming limitation.

For the exact-projection question, specify the finite representation class and complexity dependence on K, n, and m, and prove coverage first for the primitive simultaneous confidence region before projecting it through nonempty fibers.

recommended_next_step: Revise the mixture-sign-radius target to define the perturbed-mixture compatible-law convention, then continue this field-tier partial-identification angle to Stage 0.
